source.publication: 2025 NJ-1040 Instructions (with GIT-1 & 2 Retirement Income, January 2026, and njit6/njit7 web pages where named)
source.section: Form NJ-1040 lines 15, 20a, 27, 28a, 29: Instr PDF p.22 line 28a chart column $100,001-$125,000 ('50% of line 20a'), PDF p.21 line 27, PDF p.23 Worksheet D; GIT-1 & 2 p.19; PDF p.8 lines 6-7 (regular and senior 65+ exemptions), PDF p.9 line 13, PDF p.25 line 30, PDF p.27 lines 38-39, PDF p.33 lines 42-43, PDF p.65 Tax Rate Schedules

worked: Federal AGI 110,000.00 (pensions 50,000.00 + 40,000.00 + spouse 2 wages 20,000.00); federal taxable income = 110,000.00 - 34,700.00 federal standard deduction (31,500 joint + 1,600 x 2 for two spouses 65 or older) = 75,300.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Line 15 wages 20,000.00 + line 20a pensions 90,000.00 = line 27 total income 110,000.00; measure 110,000.00, in the 100,001-125,000 band, joint share 0.5. Line 28a: both spouses 62 or older; Line A = 90,000.00, Line B = 50% of line 20a 90,000.00 = 45,000.00; lesser = 45,000.00. Projection: 0.5 x lesser of (pension 90,000.00, cap 100,000.00) = 45,000.00 (the same, because the pension is under the cap). Line 28b: wages 20,000 are more than 3,000, so no unclaimed exclusion; the projection has no covered interest, dividends or gains: 0.00. Line 29 New Jersey gross income = 110,000.00 - 45,000.00 - 0.00 = 65,000.00. Line 30 exemptions (line 13): regular 1,000 x 2 + senior 65+ 1,000 x 2 = 4,000.00; line 38 = 4,000.00 (no other deductions). Line 39/42 taxable income = 65,000.00 - 4,000.00 = 61,000.00. Line 43 tax, rate schedule Table B (joint/head of household/qualifying widow(er)) as bands: 20,000.00 x 0.014 = 280.00 + 30,000.00 x 0.0175 = 525.00 + 11,000.00 x 0.0245 = 269.50 = 1,074.50. The booklet's Tax Table (taxable income under 100,000) gives 1,075 for the 61,000-61,050 row (schedule at the midpoint 61,025, rounded); expected keeps the exact schedule result. No credits. State income tax = 1,074.50. The pension is noncontributory, so the New Jersey taxable amount (line 20a) equals the federal taxable amount and line 20b is empty.
accepted_approximations: Tax Table: for taxable income under 100,000 New Jersey uses its Tax Table, the schedule's tax at each 50-dollar row's midpoint rounded to the dollar; the projection uses the exact schedule.
